payload.recallText: I was a journalist working on a student newspaper when I was interviewing the dean. I asked him if trying to attract more well heeled students would be betraying the university's mission. The dean said "Listen punk." Just then a masked person came out of nowhere and threw a pie in the dean's face. I was surprised by this and asked the dean if he had any comment about the incident. He answered "Fuck you." later at the paper I asked my editor, who later won a Pulitzer Prize, if he wanted to run the story and he said yes. So I ran the story with some embellishments. I put a cape on the pie thrower and had him recite a Latin phrase that translates to "I am not an animal." Those embellishments made the story popular with the other students who began wearing capes around campus. I also went to interview the student body president, a woman named Sheila. She was one of the well heeled students like what the dean wanted to attract. She also made it policy that barbeques would no longer allow beer. Boo. While interviewing her, the Pie Man, as he was known now, came out of nowhere and threw a pie in her face too and repeated the Latin phrase that I made up he said the first time. Then I was in a bar and a girl I like asked if  was the Pie Man. Of course I wasn't, but I knew if I said I was that the girl would sleep with me. So I said "Yes, I am the Pie Man." And the girl said, "Okay then, lets sit down and have you buy me a drink."
